mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_landlord_review (reviewer_id, landlord_id, house_id, score, content, is_anonymous, status, created_at) VALUES (#{reviewerId}, #{landlordId}, #{houseId}, #{score}, #{content}, #{isAnonymous}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.reviewer_id, r.landlord_id, r.house_id, r.score, r.content, r.is_anonymous, r.status, r.created_at, IF(r.is_anonymous=1,'匿名用户',u.username) AS reviewer_name, u.avatar AS reviewer_avatar, h.title AS house_title FROM t_landlord_review r LEFT JOIN t_user u ON r.reviewer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_house h ON r.house_id = h.id WHERE r.landlord_id = #{landlordId} AND r.status IN ('APPROVED','published') ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.reviewer_id, r.landlord_id, r.house_id, r.score, r.content, r.is_anonymous, r.status, r.created_at, IF(r.is_anonymous=1,'匿名用户',u.username) AS reviewer_name, u.avatar AS reviewer_avatar, h.title AS house_title FROM t_landlord_review r LEFT JOIN t_user u ON r.reviewer_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_house h ON r.house_id = h.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT IFNULL(AVG(score), 0) FROM t_landlord_review WHERE landlord_id = #{landlordId} AND status IN ('APPROVED','published')
